races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged due to camber, especially in large fields

verdict.comment: The withdrawal of Sovereign Spell promotes ALVIN to first choice. Stellar Sunrise is second pick.

comments.alvin: Travelled nicely for a long way in 5f event at Newmarket; likely to improve; respected
comments.arjack: Never landed a blow in 5f event at Ascot; may do better over this extra furlong
comments.goldwork: Never-dangerous eighth at Ascot but shaped as if this longer trip is needed
comments.missionclassified: 75,000gns yearling; by Acclamation; couple of 2yo winners on dam's side
comments.orangeemperor: 90,000gns yearling; pedigree suggests he's one for later on
comments.sovereignspell: Brings the best form, having finished second at Newmarket on 1,000 Guineas day
comments.stellarsunrise: 130,000gns yearling; by Space Blues; yard won this race with a newcomer in 2021

races.raceComment: alvin is marginally preferred with a score of 17.1%. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.alcazan: Two course wins over 6f; has won at 5f and this could be run to suit her
comments.almatystar: Dropped away at Epsom last time but in good form on AW previously; C&D winner; contender
comments.cinqueverde: Has won on turf but better on AW; 5lb lower mark today than when a fine second latest
comments.enchanting: Two C&D wins last year; absent since a poor York run in October; can fluff the start
comments.faustus: On winnng mark and 2nd run this year was better than his reappearance; other pace on show
comments.kissandrun: C&D winner; sharper for last month's reappearance; one of a number of front-runners
comments.marchingmac: Flourished last autumn but he returns off a tough mark; others much safer
comments.mcloven: Speedy front-runner who has run well in all three C&D runs; been gelded; one to consider
comments.michaelasboy: Two AW wins over the winter; fair fourth back on turf latest; sharp 5f suits
comments.missshowoff: Easy win in a small field 19 days ago; still low mileage but an 8lb rise is tough
comments.moulinbooj: Admirably consistent; should enjoy the likely pace set up here; each-way claims again
comments.rockingends: Talented but free-going sprinter; sharper for recent run; Rossa Ryan booked; contender
comments.twilightfun: Flopped at Epsom latest but that run is easy to excuse; hugely progressive on AW before

comments.joychoi: Remote last of five on her comeback from almost a year off; 2-3 wins came on soft ground
comments.kensingtonagent: Victory and a third to her name in two starts here and handles fast ground; considered
comments.maidinchelsea: Well held in two handicaps, including on her recent comeback (good to firm)
comments.notremaison: Two solid efforts without the usual headgear this spring; fine on this ground; shortlisted
comments.olympicquest: Regressive mare who's only run once in a sprint; makes little appeal from 8lb wrong
comments.shibuyastorm: Struggled once handicapping, coming 9lb down the weights; not obviously fancied on return
comments.vaunted: Fine on fast turf and popped up at big prices twice last autumn; no surprise to see better

verdict.comment: Preference is for MOUNT KING, who is proven around here and was in good form prior to a lacklustre effort last time.

comments.captaincorelli: Ended 2025 with career-best; 8lb higher now but he could still have more to come; player.
comments.commanderoflife: Best turf effort when fourth at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) latest; should be involved.
comments.highlandolly: Up 2lb for career-best win; if handling this stiffer track he should be in the mix.
comments.milteye: 1m winner who is an each-way player based on both efforts since joining this trainer.
comments.mountking: C&D winner; disappointed latest at Thirsk but he's a player if putting that behind him.
comments.myhoneyb: Well beaten on reappearance at Doncaster; headgear now goes on; plenty to prove.
comments.parislights: Over 1l to find with Commander Of Life on same terms as at Wetherby latest; more needed.
comments.valueadded: 9.5f winner; has been well beaten on all three starts for current yard; plenty to prove.

races.raceComment: highlandolly is marginally preferred with a score of 53.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over mountking. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.raceComment: recordart is marginally preferred with a score of 51.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over scintillante. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
